# A list's format folded where its receiver is a constant: html's fold
# interpreted the method's body with no binding for the receiver's T, and the
# `_format` of each element formatted nothing, so `"{xs}"`-style comparisons
# folded to false. The folder answers a method on a generic type by its own
# implementation, as it did while the receiver was implicit.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"

func langs(l string) list[string] {
    return match l {
        "ja" => ["ja", "ja-hrkt", "en"]
        else => ["en"]
    }
}

func testFormatFolds(t test.Test) {
    t.assert(["ja", "en"].format(",") == "ja,en")
    t.assert(langs("ja").format(",") == "ja,ja-hrkt,en")
    t.assert(langs("ja").format(",") == "ja,ja-hrkt,en" && langs("pt").format(",") == "en")
}
